analyst_view.overall: Rayo (14th, 12 pts, no away win but 10 points from five home games) host Valencia (19th, 9 pts) at Vallecas on Saturday afternoon, with Valencia in the drop zone and four of the last five meetings drawn. Rayo miss Batalla, Luiz Felipe and Óscar Valentín (in the numbers), and Álvaro García, Vertrouwd and Kumbulla are doubts; Camello (seven league goals) leads the line. Valencia have Gayà banned and miss Jesús Vázquez, Diego López and Canós, so Maffeo is expected at left-back; Danjuma and Sadiq were expected to be available after late tests, while Otorbi is very unlikely. José Luis Munuera Montero referees, and the numbers now include his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals and already add for Gayà's ban and take a little off for the many draws between these sides. Danjuma is back in training, possibly for minutes off the bench, and Rayo may lack Álvaro García's width; these are small and pull both ways, so I stay at 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners and already add some for Valencia conceding plenty lately (39 in six games). Maffeo playing out of position at left-back could let Ratiu and De Frutos reach the byline, but Álvaro García's doubt may cost Rayo some width on the other flank, so I keep 10.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards; they now include referee Munuera Montero (4.6 a game over 44 games, a light 3.0 yellows a game this season) and add about 13% for Valencia's heavy recent card count. Yesterday I trimmed for him because the numbers had no referee; now that they count him, trimming again would count him twice, and a tense relegation fight points the other way, so I stay at 4.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.0 shots and already add about 22% to Rayo for their heavy shooting against a Valencia side that concedes many attempts. Danjuma's possible return and Álvaro García's doubt roughly cancel, so I keep 29.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target, with Rayo's recent form already counted. Camello is in good scoring form and Sadiq is expected to start for Valencia, as the numbers assume; nothing new changes either attack, so I stay at 8.4.
